name: Restrained narrator edit

edit.guidance: Cut dead air and redundant pauses; preserve breaths or brief pauses needed for intelligibility and natural delivery.

captions.guidance: Use accurate, readable phrases; prior user preference is manual text rather than editor auto-captions.

hook_text.guidance: Make the opening promise legible without competing with speech captions.

sfx.guidance: Use sparingly at meaningful moments, never automatically on every cut.

animation.guidance: Light explanatory animation may clarify a concept. Select a style before generating assets; none is defined yet.

constraints: Narrator and explanation remain the focus.
Sound effects must not mask speech or be obnoxious.
Do not add effects or animation solely to fill time.

user_defined: Optional light animation with styles to be defined
carried_from_prior_preference: Manually timed caption text from the final edit
